prompt:
Draw or update a design diagram in wordsmith (the Design page; give it a project and it also shows in that project's Designs tab).
Your wordsmith token is in the WORDSMITH_TOKEN environment variable. Send it as "Authorization: Bearer $WORDSMITH_TOKEN".

Over MCP: use the create_diagram, get_diagram and update_diagram tools.
Over HTTP:
- Read the API index first: GET {origin}/api/v1
- Create: POST {origin}/api/v1/diagrams { name, project?, description?, nodes: [{ id, title, kind, text?, inside? }], edges: [{ from, to, label? }] }
- Read: GET {origin}/api/v1/diagrams/{id}
- Change: PATCH {origin}/api/v1/diagrams/{id} { add_nodes?, remove_nodes?, add_edges?, remove_edges? }

Kinds: client, service, worker, database, storage, queue, external, agent, zone (a boundary such as a cloud, region or device; put boxes in it with inside), text.
Leave x and y out: the server lays boxes out along the arrows. Give every box a short id and use it in edges.
Show each deployable unit, each data store and each external system once, name the protocol or payload on every arrow, and keep it under 30 boxes.
